# ChatterBox — Free AI Chatbot UI Template (React / Next.js)

> ChatterBox is a free, open-source AI chatbot UI template for React and
> Next.js. It is built entirely with VivekUI, a free React component library
> with zero runtime dependencies. The template is UI only: there is no model,
> no SDK and no API key anywhere in it, so it sits in front of whatever
> backend you already run.

Built with VivekUI — a free React component library with zero runtime
dependencies: 91 accessible components and 6 SVG charts. One install, one CSS
import, no config.

- Install: npm i @the_viveksingh/vivek-ui
- Docs: https://ui.vivekkumarsingh.in/docs
- Component reference: https://ui.vivekkumarsingh.in/docs/components
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@the_viveksingh/vivek-ui
- GitHub (library): https://github.com/intellectwithvivek/vivek_UI
- Author: https://vivekkumarsingh.in/
- License: MIT (library and template)

## This site

- Live demo: https://aichat-vivekui.vercel.app
- Template repository: nextjs-ai-chatbot-ui-template-vivekui
- Stack: Next.js 16 (App Router) · React 19 · TypeScript 5 · VivekUI 0.5.x
- Routes: / (landing) · /chat (working mock chat app) · /built-with
  (component attribution)

## Key facts

- The landing page hero is not a screenshot. It is a real ChatThread playing a
  scripted conversation, with TypingIndicator between turns and a live
  ChatCodeBlock answer.
- Charts render inside chat message bubbles. In /chat, typing "show me a
  chart" or "usage stats" returns an assistant reply containing a real SVG
  BarChart inside the ChatMessage. The chart and the chat come from the same
  package.
- Replies are keyword-matched from data/replies.ts. No network request is made
  and nothing the visitor types leaves the browser.
- VivekUI declares no runtime dependencies — only React as a peer. No
  Tailwind, no styled-components, no icon package, no charting library, no CLI
  that copies files into your repository.
- Dark mode is one attribute on <html> and works with JavaScript disabled.
  Theming is CSS custom properties; the emerald accent on this site is two
  declarations.
- Accessibility: each chat turn is an <article> so screen readers can step
  turn by turn; the typing indicator sits outside the transcript live region
  so a streaming reply does not announce repeatedly; every chart ships a
  visually hidden table of the real numbers.

## VivekUI chat components used here

ChatThread, ChatMessage, ChatInput, TypingIndicator, ChatCodeBlock — a family
almost no free UI library ships.

## Charts used here

BarChart (inside a chat message), LineChart, ProgressRing — from
@the_viveksingh/vivek-ui/charts.
